positions.description: Every position under test; a two-position task (e.g. their case against our Reply) has two entries.

limbs.description: The position's distinct operative limbs: liability/entitlement and each pleaded head of relief or recovery. breaks_position fires when any limb falls.

depends_on_other_party_breach.description: True when the position rests on the other party's breach, delay or non-performance. Each flagged position requires a causation-family finding whose position_owner equals this owner; any against_position must equal that same owner. Another owner's finding does not satisfy this requirement.

brief.description: Compact reading-view prose shared by chat and optional export. Findings carry the analysis once.

position_name.description: Short name for the title line.

summary.description: At most five sentences: position, what was done, what was found, the single most useful next step.

checkpoint.description: What the lawyer was shown at Transmission 1 and what it rested on. The map may be posted before the whole bundle is read; this block makes that honest.

map_read.description: Selected documents that had been read when the map was posted; at least one.

map_changed_after_full_read.description: True if reading the rest of the bundle changed a position, limb or the strongest route after the lawyer confirmed the map.

change_note.description: Required when map_changed_after_full_read is true: one sentence on what changed; the same sentence opens Transmission 2.

status.description: Actual confirmation status; silence in an interactive run is unanswered and never authorises adjudication.

incomplete_reason.description: Required when verdict is incomplete: exactly what is missing or unusable.

coverage.description: selected must equal the disjoint union of the other four.

routes.description: Route IDs; the three lists must be disjoint.

validation_state.description: Set by the author before running the validator (not_run); the validator's exit code is authoritative.

sources.description: Selected source filename to readable name and source date; absent dates are null. Links are derived from existing files, never model-authored URLs.

source.description: Filename within the source root; must be in coverage.selected.

quote.description: Verbatim passage; validator matches it whitespace-normalised against the source file.

locator.description: Visible page, paragraph, clause or other source locator. Accuracy is not machine-verified; source name comes from sources.

calculation_receipts.description: Complete packaged-calculator JSON results supporting this finding. Preserve all outputs; the reading view states resulting dates, intervals, comparisons, assumptions and limits in plain language.

title.description: Short plain heading for the finding, used in the table and the detail.

hits.description: Required for Pressure Points: the party and limb the point hits.

next_step.description: Required for Pressure Points: the next lawful lawyer action.

smallest_change.description: Optional: the smallest change of fact that would change the result.

what_would_close.description: Optional on proof_gap: the evidence that would close the watch item.

test_family.description: The Step 4 family the attack belongs to. Optional, except that each position flagged depends_on_other_party_breach requires a causation-family finding linked by position_owner to that same owner.

position_owner.description: Owner of the position under attack, not the quote author; must match a positions[].owner and any against_position.

against_position.description: Required for breaks_position and internal_defect: the tested position owner; must equal position_owner whenever present, on any classification.

flip_statement.description: Required iff classification is breaks_position: 'if accepted, [focal conclusion] fails because ...'. Two breaks_position findings with the same flip statement are one Pressure Point; the validator faults the duplicate.

defect_statement.description: Required iff classification is internal_defect: 'as drafted, [A] and [B] cannot both be accurate because ...'. internal_defect also requires both conflicting anchors (minItems 2 in practice) and survives.

survives.description: Required iff classification is breaks_position: what remains sound after the criticism.

dispositive_anchor_note.description: For defeated/weakens_route: which source answers the attack or which route survives.
